title: PR #6490 moved structure-board rendering into a new generic render_object_structure admin endpoint and dropped the user_can_change_page check the old details() path applied, so any staff user can read the plugin structure of pages they may not view.

findings.explanation: The diff does not introduce any SQL queries. It adds authorization checks and cycle detection logic. No user-controlled input is used in raw SQL queries.

The changes add authorization checks to prevent unauthorized access to source placeholders during copy operations (lines 540-550 and 582-593). The code checks source-side permissions before allowing plugins/placeholders to be copied, preventing information disclosure. The cycle detection (lines 788-802) prevents DoS via infinite recursion. Authorization checks use `has_add_plugins_permission()` and `check_source()` methods on placeholder objects, which appear to be proper authorization enforcement mechanisms. The structure endpoint tests (test_views.py) confirm that view-restricted pages are denied access.
